answers.core: This is about improving the performance of 2D games on low-end hardware.
answers.workaround:
Really, other than preformance, this is not required and the user can continue working on the project. However, if the user would like, one workaround to have Vector2 without decimals can be to add this line of code to _process() for every Node2D that needs decimal position:

`position=floor(position)`

However, this will decrease performance as it is an extra step every time _process() is called and may cause instability in the position, potentially leading to other bugs (possibly collision related).

title: Make it possible to use integers for Node2D positions
